headline: Clean waist-high peelers this morning — nice if you're already out here.
today: Best conditions of the region this morning actually — 2ft at 7s on a prime angle with a light N offshore through mid-morning, then it goes light and variable. Fun little log session but it's a 2.5hr drive for waist-high, so this is a locals-only day. Don't burn the tank on it.

daysToWatch.note: 1-1.9ft but the S swell stretches to 9s at a prime angle and NW is cross-off through the morning. Cleanest Ditch day of the stretch, though still on the small side for the drive.
Biggest raw size at 3ft but it's short-period S and the wind swings onshore by afternoon. Morning's your only shot and it's marginal — not worth the haul.
Decent size on a prime S angle but W blows 18-19mph cross all day. Junk.
